text:
maria: Quick check — we have an APAC customer demo next Tue and need low-latency. Can we borrow 4 A100s from the dedicated-eu pool into apac-demo for ~48h? Vendor says +8 arriving but delivery might be late. Who can approve/move? :pray:

devon: We can do a pool reassign but need zone quota freed in APAC. @quota-bot can you dump current reserved vs free in both zones? :eyes:

quota-bot: eu-west1-a: 32 A100 reserved (dedicated-eu)
apac-southeast1-a: 8 A100 reserved (apac-demo)
free ephemeral in apac-southeast1-a: 2
vendor incoming: +8 (ETA Mar 18)

jordan: We can spare 4 from dedicated-eu for 48h if no spike. I can schedule the swap at 06:00 UTC Mon to avoid churn. Need approval from @ana_procurement for billing amendment.

ana_procurement: short-term shift ok. Confirming billing: the reassign will still be under "Dedicated" contract, but we'll create a 48h amendment so customer trial is covered. @louis_ops can you confirm cost neutral?

louis_ops: cost neutral — trial credit covers it. Also confirm apac-demo has the right subnets/firewalls for the GPUs. @devon can you run a smoke after move?

devon: Plan: 1) reserve 4 A100s in eu pool (mark ephemeral) 2) reassign to apac-demo 3) run smoke: `./scripts/smoke-gpu.sh --region=apac` 4) rollback if perf fails. I’ll open infra-scripts PR with the exact commands.

maria: thanks — can you paste the gcloud commands here so I can add them to the runbook?

devon: ```
# reassign reserved instances
gcloud compute reservations update dedicated-eu --zone=eu-west1-a --remove-instances=4
gcloud compute reservations update apac-demo --zone=apac-southeast1-a --add-instances=4
```

procurement-bot: Note: reassign will generate a billing delta. Ticket created: PR-4527 (48h amendment).

jordan: :thumbsup: I’ll do the move Mon 06:00 UTC and post logs here. tagging @maria for final demo details.

maria: Confirmed — demo starts Tue 03:00 UTC. Appreciate the quick turnaround :rocket:
